item.title: Dropping the needle: Best uses of songs in iconic films
item.description: Oftentimes, the most memorable cinematic moments occur when our favorite songs play, blending two iconic art forms. In all of these exemplary needle drops, the lyrics and sound perfectly align with the story and characters. Emotions are evoked by the simple riff of a guitar or the gentle cry of a piano. These are the moments that make movies magic.

item.title: Boston University not changing course with DEI programs after anti DEI directive declared unlawful
item.description: Boston University has not announced if they will reinstate last year’s eliminated DEI programs after anti-DEI initiatives declared unlawful.

item.title: The Boston winter I was always warned about | The Senior Scaries
item.description: I guess eventually hating the weather really is just part of the Boston winter experience — dreaming of snow and being sick of it by March. All in all, I’m just glad that I experienced a BU snow storm once in my four years here, and now I’m fully ready to move on to warmer weather.

item.title: One week of spring break isn’t going to solve all of your problems, but it doesn’t have to
item.description: Having the freedom to do nothing for seven days is a luxury. Being able to live in peace for a week is a privilege that we shouldn't forget to acknowledge. With our hectic lives in college, we should allow ourselves grace with a chance to just catch our breath. And at the end of the week, when the question, "What did you do during spring break?" comes around, it's perfectly fine to shrug and say, "Nothing much."

item.title: ‘Our chemistry is unmatched’: BU softball wins three of four as underdogs in the Duke Invitational
item.description: When you talk to members of the Boston University softball team, currently in the preseason of their campaign for a fourth straight Patriot League title, patterns begin to emerge: perseverance, determination and love for one another.

item.title: Women’s basketball collapses in the fourth quarter, drops regular-season finale 64-58 to Holy Cross
item.description: Entering the fourth quarter with a 9-point lead, the Boston University women's basketball team was cruising against the Holy Cross Crusaders.

item.title: Bruins prospect Jonathan Morello has found a home on Commonwealth Avenue
item.description: As Jonathan Morello opened up scoring for the Terriers in the 2026 Beanpot Semifinal against Northeastern on Feb. 2, his name flashed across the big screen at TD Garden.

item.title: The Artificial Majority | The Monkey’s Paw
item.description: Advertising is a dull corporate organ that interrupts our daily lives, sure — but it’s also an important cultural litmus. The capacities and applications of AI evolve every passing day. Unless we remain informed and engaged enough to make decisions around its acceptable use, those choices will be made for us by people in power — elected or not.

item.title: I want to major in media literacy with a concentration in pop culture
item.description: Media literacy is not only relevant to the world of pop culture, though many examples can be found there. When audiences can better evaluate and comprehend political discourse, they strengthen their democracies and combat misinformation. Media literacy skills also foster open-mindedness, helping to create empathetic, healthier and better-informed communities.

item.title: BU students housed in Hyatt hotel face lengthy laundry commute, expensive laundry plans
item.description: Boston University students placed in the Hyatt Regency hotel in Cambridge by BU Housing have two options for laundry: Use any of the on-campus laundry facilities or purchase one of four laundry plans, which range from $379 to $999.
